verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents running a range of models from one runtime: text, vision, images, video and voice, plus loading arbitrary GGUF models from HuggingFace or Ollama, a built-in gallery, and multiple backends. That covers LLMs and multi-modal workloads. missing for 10: evidence of support for hundreds of distinct architectures, explicit MoE model support, explicit embedding-model support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models

citations.quote: Text, voice, vision, images, video, 3D and agents, from one open runtime.
Install models from the built-in gallery (Discover page)
LocalAI supports running the OpenAI functions and tools API across multiple backends.
